about_the_game:
Welcome to Neko Café Stories, a cozy and relaxing bubble merge puzzle game set in a stylish anime café run by charming neko girls. Match and merge colorful sweets to unlock new characters and progress through fun, dessert-themed challenges!

🍰 Core Gameplay
At the heart of the game is a satisfying bubble merge mechanic — drag and combine matching sweets on the puzzle board to create new ones, complete level objectives, and earn delicious cakes.
Every few levels, a new character is revealed, adding variety and charm to your journey.

😺 Key Features

  • A single, elegant café managed by unique anime-style neko girls.

  • Meet 9 different girls, each unlocked by completing 3 bubble merge puzzle levels.

  • Smooth and rewarding merging system with clever layouts and gameplay twists like portals.

  • Hand-drawn anime visuals with polished details and soothing background music.

  • Progress through relaxing levels and enjoy visually delightful rewards.

If you're a fan of laid-back puzzle games with merging mechanics, cute character design, and a relaxing vibe, Neko Café Stories is your perfect treat.

          

Under the pouring rain, you find shelter in a mysterious café where catgirls work.

Each of them has her own story, and you are a random guest who might stay here for a long time...

short_description: Enter a cozy world where cute anime girls decorate a café by merging magical bubbles into rare, beautiful items. Relax, merge, and uncover the story!
